evidence.quote: Probably: move up/down/left/right, and one other action (interact/jump?).

I1.rationale: Single leading control hypothesis states four directions; exact action mapping is not required by I1. Thinking also says move up/down/left/right. Borderline belief threshold: uncertainty is mapping, not a competing directional-control hypothesis.
